User.title: User
User.description: User profile and cryptographic public identity for SAT Messenger

publicKey.description: Base64 encoded cryptographic public key for E2EE

bio.description: Short user bio or status phrase

whatsappLinked.description: WhatsApp linked account details (phoneNumber, linkedAt, status, verified)

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A direct, group, or community chat room in SAT Messenger

adminIds.description: List of group admin user IDs

disappearingTimerSeconds.description: Disappearing message lifetime in seconds (0 for disabled)

lastMessageSnippet.description: Summary preview snippet of the latest message

lastMessageSenderId.description: UID of the user who sent the latest message

lastMessageTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last sent message

encryptionFingerprint.description: Verification fingerprint hash for E2EE security

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An end-to-end encrypted message, voice note, document, or location payload

ciphertext.description: Encrypted message payload or attachment ciphertext

textPreview.description: Optional local preview or fallback indicator

mediaData.description: Data URL or encoded payload for audio, documents, photos

mediaName.description: File name for shared documents or media

audioDuration.description: Duration in seconds of voice note

transcription.description: Automatic speech-to-text transcript of voice note

location.description: Latitude, longitude and place name if location message

readBy.description: List of user IDs who read the message

reactions.description: Map of emoji reaction characters to arrays of user IDs who reacted

expiresAt.description: UNIX timestamp when message must self-destruct

TypingStatus.title: TypingStatus
TypingStatus.description: Real-time typing indicator for active conversations

BackupRecord.title: BackupRecord
BackupRecord.description: Cloud-based encrypted backup record for cross-device message sync

userId.description: User UID who owns the backup

backupData.description: Encrypted JSON bundle of all chats and messages

deviceLabel.description: Device name or platform that created backup

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: End-to-end encrypted messages and attachments in a conversation
